title: [BUG] sum_to_n() returns wrong result — off-by-one in range
description: The function sum_to_n(n) in samples/ado/buggy_calculator.py uses range(1, n) which excludes n itself. For n=5 it returns 10 instead of the correct 15. The fix is to change range(1, n) to range(1, n + 1). Additionally, safe_divide() has no guard for b == 0 which causes ZeroDivisionError.

acceptance_criteria: sum_to_n(n) returns the correct sum for all n >= 0
safe_divide(a, 0) raises ValueError with clear message
